name: dsh-web-fetch-local
description: `web_fetch` tool backed by local Python urllib (HTTP + SSRF + JSON-LD) and Node-side Turndown + GFM (HTML→Markdown). Reuses DSH's bundled turndown via install.py junction bridge.

turndown.comment: Provided by DSH itself (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` ships it). install.py creates a directory junction `~/.dsh/plugins/web-fetch-local/node_modules` -> the DSH package's node_modules so Node module resolution finds it. If the junction is missing, the tool degrades to text-only mode.

@joplin/turndown-plugin-gfm.comment: Provided by DSH itself. Same junction mechanism as `turndown`.

optionalDependencies_comment: Python `extruct` and `brotli` (pip install) are optional. With `extruct`, the tool extracts JSON-LD / Microdata / OpenGraph / RDFa / Microformat from the page and surfaces them as `metadata`; without it `metadata` is null. With `brotli`, `br`-encoded responses decode; without it they report a decode error. Both degrade gracefully.
